preconditions.description: The dimensions of the playing field must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in field)
preconditions.description: Each row of the playing field must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for row in field for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the playing field must be either '#' or '.'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(c == '.' for row in field for c in row) else True
postconditions.description: If there are any empty cells left after filling, output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '#0123456789' for row in field for c in row)
postconditions.description: All cells in the output must be either '#' or a digit representing a figure.

postconditions.expression: all(c == '#' for row in field for c in row if c in '#')
postconditions.description: Initially filled cells must remain represented by '#' in the output.
